dataset_id.identifier: Non-sensitive computational materials and selected research outputs may be deposited in public repositories such as Zenodo and GitHub. Institutional repositories may also be used for long-term storage and dissemination of documentation, scripts, and reproducible computational workflows. Sensitive medical imaging data will not be publicly released.

dataset.description: This DMP describes the management of MRI datasets, numerical simulations, trained models, and computational results generated during the project.

format:
The project will use anonymized MRI image datasets, synthetic deformation datasets, finite element simulation outputs, trained neural-operator models, and numerical evaluation results.

MRI images may be stored in medical imaging or standard image formats such as NIfTI (.nii), PNG (.png), or NumPy arrays (.npy). Synthetic datasets and numerical simulation outputs will mainly be stored as NumPy arrays (.npy), CSV files (.csv), and VTK files (.vtk). Trained machine learning models and checkpoints will be stored using PyTorch formats (.pt, .pth). Computational scripts and configuration files will be stored as Python scripts (.py), text files (.txt), and JSON configuration files (.json).

distribution.available_until: No formal embargo period is currently planned for non-sensitive computational outputs. Public release of scripts, numerical configurations, or synthetic datasets, when applicable, will occur after validation of the project results and completion of the Master’s thesis. Sensitive medical imaging data will remain under restricted access and will not be publicly distributed.

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan describes the procedures for storage, processing, organization, protection, and possible sharing of data generated during the project “Physics-Informed Operator Learning for MRI-Based Muscle Strain Estimation”. The project is developed within the scope of a Master’s thesis in Applied Mathematics for Industry and involves MRI image processing, numerical simulations, and machine learning workflows.
The project will generate anonymized MRI datasets, synthetic deformation data, finite element simulation outputs, trained neural-operator models, and numerical evaluation results. The DMP defines strategies for secure storage, backup procedures, computational reproducibility, and management of non-sensitive research outputs.
